title: Potent anti-tumor immunity and reversal of CD8 T cell exhaustion by targeting Treg cells
author: Yuzhou, Chang
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate GFP+ Tregs by FACS
steps.instruction: Purify 1×10^6 splenic GFP‑positive Treg cells from each wild‑type (n=4) and knockout (n=4) mouse using fluorescence‑activated cell sorting (FACS).

steps.title: Extract RNA with RNeasy Micro Kit
steps.instruction: Lyse the sorted cells and extract total RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy Micro Kit according to the manufacturer’s standard protocol; assess RNA integrity and contamination on a 1% agarose gel.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the extracted RNA using the NEBNext® Ultra™ RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina® (NEB, USA) following the kit’s recommendations and incorporate index codes to label each sample.

steps.title: Generate clusters on cBot
steps.instruction: Load the indexed libraries onto the Illumina cBot Cluster Generation System and perform cluster generation with the PE Cluster Kit cBot‑HS according to Illumina’s instructions.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina platform
steps.instruction: Run the clustered libraries on an Illumina sequencer to obtain paired‑end reads; all samples are prepared simultaneously and sequenced on the same lane.

steps.title: Convert raw images to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Transform the original image data files into sequenced reads (FASTQ format) using Illumina’s CASAVA base‑calling software.

steps.title: Clean raw reads with fastp
steps.instruction: Process the FASTQ files with fastp to produce clean reads by removing adapter sequences, poly‑N stretches, and low‑quality reads.

steps.title: Download reference genome and annotation
steps.instruction: Obtain the mouse reference genome and gene model annotation files from the NCBI/UCSC/Ensembl genome browsers.

steps.title: Map reads with STAR
steps.instruction: Align the paired‑end clean reads to the downloaded reference genome using the STAR (Spliced Transcripts Alignment to a Reference) software.

steps.title: Count gene reads with FeatureCounts
steps.instruction: Use FeatureCounts to count the number of reads mapped to each gene from the STAR alignment output.

steps.title: Calculate gene expression (RPKM)
steps.instruction: Compute RPKM (Reads Per Kilobase of exon model per Million mapped reads) for each gene based on gene length and the counted read numbers.

steps.title: Upload results to project repository
steps.instruction: Upload the FPKM gene expression matrix, accompanying R code, differential expression gene (DEG) list, and targeted gene list to the project’s data repository.
